gnome-rock.description: Lineage of born tinkerers. You repair and create small wonders. You choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as your spellcasting ability.
gnome-rock.features.0.description: You know the Mending and Prestidigitation cantrips, and you can build a small clockwork device.
gnome-rock.features.0.effects.2.description: You can spend 10 minutes casting Prestidigitation to create a Tiny clockwork device (AC 5, 1 HP) that produces one of the spell's effects when you activate it with a touch as a Bonus Action. You can have up to three devices at a time; each falls apart 8 hours after you create it or when you dismantle it with a touch as a Utilize action.
